summary.zh: 规划主题集群、内容日历，并对应漏斗阶段与搜索需求
summary.en: Plan topic clusters and a content calendar tied to funnel stages

description.zh: 决定接下来该写什么：把选题收拢成主题集群，按搜索需求和漏斗阶段排序，排出可执行的发布计划。适合已有内容但没方向，或要从零搭内容体系时使用。集群脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Decides what to write next: topic clusters ranked by search demand and funnel stage, then an executable plan. Use it when content has no direction or when building a system from zero. The cluster script needs local Python.
